scripts.ingest: ../.pyenv/bin/python ../scripts/build_drawing_grammar.py --output .k3d-data/galaxy_pending/drawing_grammar.jsonl && ../.pyenv/bin/python -c "import json; lines=[]; f=open('.k3d-data/galaxy_pending/drawing_grammar.jsonl'); [lines.append(f'{json.loads(l).get(\"id\",\"\")}: {json.loads(l).get(\"visual_rpn\",\"\") or json.loads(l).get(\"type\",\"\")}') for l in f if l.strip()]; open('.k3d-data/drawing_grammar.txt','w').write('\n'.join(lines))" && ../.pyenv/bin/python -m k3dgen --text .k3d-data/drawing_grammar.txt --gltf ../viewer/public/galaxy.glb --k 3 --reducer pca
scripts.dev: bun run ingest && bunx concurrently -n viewer,bridge -c blue,green "bun run viewer" "bun run bridge"
